title: Interesting
text: Really interesting. It was nice to learn more about the history of Seville while walking through a really beautiful area of town. Our guide was knowledgeable and very helpful.
author: Abbie_H

title: Tour of Seville Jewish Quarter
text: We loved this tour with our knowledgeable tour guide.  She picked us up at the meeting point and we headed through Santa Cruz as she explained the history of Jewish quarter in Seville.  A moving tour which our tour guide brought to life. Well worth our time. Thank you.
author: Samar_B

title: Excellent tour
text: The guide was excellent. Recommend this walking tour! The Santa Cruz walk is very interesting. I learnt a lot.
author: yael724

title: Walking Tour
text: Our guide was very informative and interesting. She spent a lot of time explaining the history and other insider knowledge of Seville
author: Karenc101g

title: Interesting tour through the old city center
text: The tour guide (Anna) was nice, excellent knowledge. She gave us a lot of information and nice stories which made the tour very interesting. We give only 4 points as it was sometimes impossible to understand her as she was walking and talking in parallel. Walking behind her maked it  imposible for everyone to understand  what she was saying altgough we were a small group of only 8 persons..
author: GKST1
